name: Northwind Cloud Service Level Agreement
text:
Service Level Agreement
Vendor: Northwind Cloud
Agreement: NW-2026-001
Effective: 2026-01-01 through 2026-12-31
Availability is measured over each UTC calendar month.
For Cloud Hosting on the Business plan, the monthly uptime target is 99.9%; each completed 0.1 percentage point of shortfall below the target earns a 10% service credit, capped at 100%.
Round the resulting service credit once to the nearest cent, with half cents rounded up; do not round availability or shortfall before counting completed increments.
Claims must be received within 30 calendar days after month end.
Service credits apply to affected monthly fees on a future invoice.
